title: PostgreSQL JDBC
description: PostgreSQL JDBC driver packaged for use as an external library or optional dependency for Spigot/Paper plugins.
body:
PostgreSQL JDBC driver packaged for use as an external library or optional dependency for Spigot/Paper plugins.

This plugin does not provide any functionality on its own, but can be used by other plugins that rely on JDBC connections for PostgreSQL databases.

It is a direct repackage of the official PostgreSQL JDBC driver with added plugin metadata, allowing it to be loaded by the server.
No modifications have been made to the original driver.

Compatible with Spigot and Paper from Minecraft 1.21.11 up to the latest versions.
